data.name: ManageCertificationsNote
data.value: Create, edit, suspend, verify and delete other members' certification records and credits, and unit certification records.

data.name: ViewCertificationsNote
data.value: View other members' certification records, unit certifications and the expiry dashboard. Members always see their own records.

data.name: ManageCertificationSetupNote
data.value: Manage certification types, role requirements and the department certification settings.

data.name: DashboardIntro
data.value: Who holds what, what is expiring and what has lapsed, for people and units.

data.name: ComplianceReportDescription
data.value: Printable person × type and unit × type certification matrices with expiry status.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The change could not be saved.

data.name: FileHint
data.value: PDF, image or office document, up to 10 MB.

data.name: TypesIntro
data.value: The catalog of certifications, licenses, inspections and permits your department tracks.

data.name: HelpTypes
data.value: A type has a stable code, a category, a scope (person or unit), a default validity and optional verification or credit-hour rules. Pick common ones from the template gallery.

data.name: TemplateGalleryIntro
data.value: Common credentials across fire, EMS, SAR, wildland, emergency management, industrial, security, DOT driver and vehicle compliance. Each one becomes a type your department owns and can edit.

data.name: CodeAuto
data.value: Derived from the name when empty

data.name: CodeHint
data.value: Stable identifier used by role requirements and integrations; letters, digits, dots and dashes.

data.name: CodeLockedHint
data.value: A role requirement references this type, so its code can no longer change.

data.name: RequiresVerificationHint
data.value: New records stay pending until someone with manage rights signs them off.

data.name: SettingsIntro
data.value: How role requirements are enforced and when expiry notices go out.

data.name: EnforcementWarnOnly
data.value: Warn only – allow role changes, show warnings, notify

data.name: EnforcementEnforce
data.value: Enforce – block unqualified role adds and remove members after the grace period

data.name: EnforcementHint
data.value: Enforce removes members from roles whose mandatory certifications lapsed; the removal is audited and the member is notified.

data.name: EnforceConfirm
data.value: Enforce will remove members from roles once their grace period ends. {0} mandatory requirement(s) are configured. Continue?

data.name: certifications_enforce_confirm
data.value: Confirm the switch to Enforce before saving.

data.name: RoleRemovalGraceDaysHint
data.value: Days after a mandatory certification lapses before the member is removed from the role. Each requirement can override it.

data.name: TreatPendingVerificationAsValid
data.value: Treat records pending verification as valid for role requirements

data.name: NotifyLeadDaysHint
data.value: Comma-separated, e.g. 60,30,14,7,1. One notice per record per listed day.

data.name: SendAdminDigest
data.value: Send department administrators a nightly digest

data.name: NotificationsHint
data.value: Audiences for the Certification Expiring / Expired / Role Removed and Unit Certification events are configured under

data.name: RoleRequirementsIntro
data.value: Which certification types a member must hold for this role. Rows sharing a group number are alternatives; mandatory rows block or remove under Enforce.

data.name: EnforcementOffNotice
data.value: Enforcement is off: these requirements are informational until a department administrator turns on Warn only or Enforce in

data.name: NoPersonTypes
data.value: No person-scoped certification types exist yet.

data.name: AnyOfGroupHint
data.value: Rows with the same group number are satisfied by any one of them (EMT or AEMT or Paramedic); leave blank for a stand-alone requirement.

data.name: RoleMembersBlocked
data.value: These members do not hold the certifications this role requires and were not added: {0}

data.name: RoleMembersWarned
data.value: Added with a warning – missing certifications for this role: {0}

data.name: RoleMembersNotInDepartment
data.value: These members are not in this department and were not added: {0}

data.name: RoleAssignmentBlocked
data.value: The member was created, but one or more roles were not assigned: the member does not hold the certifications those roles require.

data.name: UnitCertificationsIntro
data.value: Inspections, registration, insurance, permits and test certificates with an expiry for this unit.

data.name: NoUnitTypes
data.value: No unit-scoped certification types exist yet.

data.name: ProtectedNotice
data.value: This record is protected; identifying values show as REDACTED without a reveal grant.

data.name: RenewHint
data.value: Sets a new expiry (and optionally a new number), reactivating an expired record.

data.name: KeepCurrent
data.value: Leave empty to keep the current one

data.name: CreditProgress
